answer: A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. Before the stamp comes a fare of £38 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. A name gets on the books only through Silkbound gauntlet dealer glove seal, because a seal gauntlet dealers renew after glove market hearings. Every garden is counted once. The lantern is on the docket. The ember is checked, not assumed.
